QuestInfo.name: To the Desert...
QuestInfo.0: I'm now ready to go to wherever #p1022002# is going to take me. I should go see #p1022002# now.
QuestInfo.1: Where is #p1022002# going to take me...?
QuestInfo.2: #p1022002# has sent me to Nihal Desert.

0.0: Are you ready to leave? You seem a bit tense, since this is your first time. Don't worry, I think you'll do just fine.

yes.0: Ah, I should tell you this right now. With my abilities, I can only take you there five more times after this. If you're ready for the path ahead, please give me a moment to focus, and speak with me once more.

no.0: Please let me know when you're ready.
